definitions.explanation: A situation that is hard to deal with (na-adjective use).

examples.english: Thank you very much for everything.

examples.english: The teacher helped me a great deal. I was able to graduate thanks to the teacher.

{大変|たいへん}な⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧、{大変|たいへん}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I have three children, so it's hard.

examples.english: Thank you for helping me during a difficult time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧{大変|たいへん}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ありません→ある：00006_aru⟧。⟦{疲|つか}れました→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧。
examples.english: I have overtime every day, so it's tough. I don't have time to rest. I'm exhausted.

notes:
{大変|たいへん} has two main uses: "very" (adverb) and "difficult/tough" (na-adjective).

ADVERB USE (very):
- {大変|たいへん}⟦おいしい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧: very delicious
- {大変|たいへん}お⟦{世話|せわ}→世話：02088_sewa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧: thank you very much for your help
- {大変|たいへん}⟦{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}→申し訳：03810_moushiwake⟧⟦ありません→ある：00006_aru⟧: I'm terribly sorry

NA-ADJECTIVE USE (difficult):
- {大変|たいへん}な⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧: difficult work
- {大変|たいへん}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧: that's tough (expression of sympathy)
- {大変|たいへん}な⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have a hard time

REGISTER:
As an adverb meaning "very," {大変|たいへん} is more formal/polite than ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧. Common in formal speech and writing.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧: very (neutral)
- ⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: extremely (formal)
- ⟦すごく→すごく：18751_sugoku⟧: very (casual)
